tagline.en: Watch an ad, get 20MB at 1Mbps, in 170 countries
tagline.zh: 看一段广告换 20MB，170 国可用

description.en: Firsty is a free-first eSIM app (com.firsty.app) covering 170 countries at one price. Free tier (current official listing): watch a short ad to unlock 20MB at 1Mbps, stackable, 7-day validity, no credit card. Paid: Classic from €0.98/GB (30d) and daily Unlimited from €2 (5GB full speed then 512kbps). The older 30-min-unlimited-256kbps model has been superseded.
description.zh: Firsty 是免费优先的 eSIM 应用（com.firsty.app），170 国同价。免费档现行官方口径：看一段广告解锁 20MB@1Mbps，可叠加、7 天有效、无需信用卡。付费档：Classic 0.98 欧/GB 起（30天）、Unlimited 日包 2 欧起（5GB 全速后 512kbps）。旧的「30 分钟无限量 256kbps」模式已被替代。

details.en:
Firsty's hook is the free tier: install the eSIM, watch a short ad, get data — no payment details required. The model has changed over time (Google Play listing, 2026-09): currently 20MB per ad at 1Mbps, stackable, valid 7 days. An older community-remembered model gave 30 minutes of unlimited data at 256kbps per ad — superseded. Paid plans: Classic from €0.98/GB with 30-day validity, and daily Unlimited tiers from €2/day (5GB full speed then 512kbps).

Community single-user hands-on (2026-09, unverified): Singapore native residential IP on the free tier — not found on official pages. Long-time-accounts reportedly got the older, more generous time-based model.

Value verdict: free tier is genuinely useful for messaging; paid tiers are expensive per GB vs mainstream eSIMs.

Re-verification (2026-11-11, official plans page + store listings): the 20MB-per-ad mechanics stand; the FAQ adds a 360MB-per-24h earn cap, a 240MB balance cap with carry-over, and advertises the free tier for 162 countries (170 for paid). The help center states free sign-up needs a phone number from one of ~50 supported countries, while some marketing pages claim no registration - treat the help-center wording as authoritative. Unlimited daily plans (from EUR 2/day) confirmed on store listings.
details.zh:
Firsty 的钩子是免费档：装 eSIM、看广告、拿流量，全程不需要付款信息。模式随时间演变（Google Play 商品页，2026-09）：当前为每段广告 20MB@1Mbps、可叠加、7 天有效。社区老用户记得的旧模式是每段广告 30 分钟无限量 256kbps——已被替代。付费档：Classic 0.98 欧/GB 起、30 天有效；Unlimited 日包 2 欧起（5GB 全速后 512kbps）。

社区单用户实测（2026-09，未核实）：免费档落地新加坡原生住宅 IP——官方页无此口径。据称老账号曾享受更宽松的旧按时长模式。

性价比结论：免费档发消息够用；付费档按 GB 单价比主流 eSIM 贵。

bestFor.en: Free-data tinkerers and backup connectivity; not for heavy paid use.
bestFor.zh: 白嫖流量尝鲜与应急备用；不适合付费重度使用。

plansNote.en: Official pages re-checked 2026-11-11 (plans/firsty-free + app store listings): 20MB per ad at 1Mbps, stackable, 7-day validity; FAQ adds a 360MB per-24h earn cap and a 240MB balance cap with carry-over; free tier advertised for 162 countries (network total 170). Free-tier rules remain subject to change.
plansNote.zh: 2026-11-11 复核官方套餐页与商店页：每段广告 20MB@1Mbps、可叠加、7 天有效；FAQ 补充口径为每 24 小时最多赚 360MB、余额上限 240MB 且可结转；免费档宣传覆盖 162 国（全网 170 国）。免费档规则仍可能随时调整。

country.en: varies (nearest hub: USA / Singapore / Belgium; SG for Asia-Pacific users)
country.zh: 不定（最近枢纽：美国/新加坡/比利时；亚太用户落新加坡）

note.en: Firsty support states traffic routes through nearest network hubs in USA, Singapore or Belgium (Australian user got Singapore). An ISPreview forum thread suggests the exit servers behave like datacenter IPs (proxy/VPN blacklists). 'Singapore residential' claim unverified.
note.zh: Firsty 官方支持回复：流量经最近枢纽（美国/新加坡/比利时）出口，亚太用户常见新加坡 IP；ISPreview 论坛讨论暗示其出口类似机房 IP（命中代理黑名单）。'新加坡住宅'说法未核实。
